gloss: as appropriate; as needed; at one's discretion

definitions.gloss: as appropriate; as needed; at one's discretion; suitably
definitions.explanation: Doing something in whatever way is suitable for the situation, with the implication that the person may use their own judgment to decide the specifics.

examples.japanese: {適宜|てきぎ}{休憩|きゅうけい}してください。
{内容|ないよう}は{適宜|てきぎ}{修正|しゅうせい}する{場合|ばあい}があります。
examples.english: The content may be revised as appropriate.

examples.japanese: {現場|げんば}の{状況|じょうきょう}に{応|おう}じて{適宜|てきぎ}{判断|はんだん}してください。
examples.english: Please use your own judgment as appropriate depending on the situation on-site.

notes:
A versatile formal adverb that grants discretion to the person doing the action. When a superior says {適宜|てきぎ}やってください, it means "handle it as you see fit." Also functions as a na-adjective modifying nouns.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {適宜|てきぎ}{対応|たいおう}する: to respond as appropriate
- {適宜|てきぎ}{判断|はんだん}する: to judge at one's discretion
- {適宜|てきぎ}{修正|しゅうせい}する: to revise as needed
- {適宜|てきぎ}{休憩|きゅうけい}を{取|と}る: to take breaks as needed
- {適宜|てきぎ}な{措置|そち}: appropriate measures

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {適切|てきせつ}に: appropriately — focuses on doing something correctly; less about personal discretion
- {随時|ずいじ}: at any time / whenever — emphasizes timing flexibility rather than manner
- {臨機応変|りんきおうへん}に: flexibly / as circumstances require — emphasizes adaptability to changing conditions

REGISTER:
Formal. Very common in business communication, official documents, and instructions. In casual speech, {好|す}きなように or {自由|じゆう}に are more natural equivalents.
